overview_description.description: Digiventures drives financial institutions' digitalization and thereby financial inclusion for all customers. The company provides an omnichannel, no-code SaaS platform that digitizes financial product creation. Its state-of-the-art technology, uses the latest market trends and strategic alliances with leading software companies. Digiventures helps financial companies with their customer acquisition processes, contributing technology for both digital and physical channels. It provides SaaS solutions for lead generation, digital onboarding, and portfolio activation.
